Impact of Segmentation Methods on Predicting Fatigue-Initiating Pores from X-ray Computed Tomography Data

Justin P. Miner, Michelle Hobdari, Henry Stanton, Sneha Prabha Narra Integrating materials and manufacturing innovation 2026-07-02 10.1007/s40192-026-00467-0
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University, 5000 Forbes Ave, Pittsburgh, PA, 15213, USA
通讯: Sneha Prabha Narra @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University, 5000 Forbes Ave, Pittsburgh, PA, 15213, USA
相关性: 该论文直接研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳起裂孔的CT图像分割方法，对疲劳性能预测具有实际意义。
边界: 该论文专注于分割方法的影响，未涉及疲劳寿命数值或S-N曲线等标准机械性能数据。
动机· 评估不同CT图像分割方法对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳起裂孔预测的影响。
方法· 采用四种分割方法处理旋转弯曲疲劳试样的X-µCT数据，并用修正Murakami参数识别临界孔。
结果· 2.5D U-Net在所有案例中正确预测起裂孔，而体素指标Dice不反映疲劳相关性。
验证· 基于NIST AMBench 2025挑战的四组已知疲劳起裂孔案例进行验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· This study evaluates how different X-ray computed tomography segmentation methods affect the prediction of fatigue-initiating pores in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· Four segmentation methods (global binary, adaptive, hysteresis, 2.5D U-Net) were applied to X-µCT scans of PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V rotating bending fatigue specimens, using a modified √A parameter accounting for the bending stress gradient to locate the critical pore.
Result· Threshold-based methods predicted the fatigue-initiating pore correctly in three of four cases, while the U-Net succeeded in all four, demonstrating that voxel-wise metrics like Dice coefficient do not correlate with fatigue relevance.
Validation· The approach was validated against four test cases from the NIST AMBench 2025 challenge with known fatigue-initiating pores.

Effect of wall thickness on the microstructure and properties of Ti-6Al-4V schwarz diamond structure prepared by selective laser melting

Xinyu Zhang, Chun Guo, WenQing Li, Guangcan Huang, Qingcheng Lin et al. Materials Science and Technology 2026-07-02 10.1177/02670836261463942
单位: Anhui Science and Technology University
通讯: Chun Guo @ Anhui Science and Technology University
相关性: 这篇论文直接研究了SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V金刚石结构的力学性能，与层1关注的基本机械性能高度相关。
边界: No fatigue life or S-N data; only monotonic mechanical properties (tensile, compression, impact) are reported.
动机· 研究壁厚对SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V schwarz金刚石结构性能的影响。
方法· 制备不同壁厚的schwarz金刚石结构，进行微观组织和力学性能测试。
结果· 壁厚增加提高了拉伸、压缩和冲击性能，0.6mm壁厚拉伸强度达165.42 MPa。
验证· 通过实验测试验证力学性能与微观结构关系。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the effect of wall thickness on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V schwarz diamond structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Schwarz diamond structures with varying wall thicknesses (0.3-0.6 mm) were manufactured and characterized for porosity, microstructure, and mechanical properties under tensile, compressive, and impact loading.
Result· Increasing wall thickness enhanced tensile strength (from 68.06 to 165.42 MPa), compressive strength, and impact energy absorption, with needle-like α' martensite microstructure throughout.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing and microstructure analysis were performed on the fabricated samples.

Multi-Scale Finite Element Simulation Framework for Deformation and Damage of Large Structure Under Complex Loadings

Cheng Li, Chengqi Sun Materials 2026-07-01 10.3390/ma19132800
单位: State Key Laboratory of Nonlinear Mechanics, Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing 100190, China
通讯: Chengqi Sun @ School of Engineering Science, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing 100049, China
相关性: 该论文针对Ti-6Al-4V ELI的疲劳寿命预测建立了多尺度有限元框架，直接符合方向要求。
边界: No as-built mechanical property data reported; validation uses published experimental results.
动机· 开发适用于大型结构复杂载荷下变形与损伤分析的多尺度仿真框架
方法· 建立嵌套子模型有限元框架，从宏观至微观逐级传递位移解，结合晶体塑性方法和疲劳指示参数模型
结果· 壳体和裂纹板应力应变误差小于5%，Ti-6Al-4V ELI剪切疲劳寿命预测误差低于10%
验证· 通过壳体静压实验和含裂纹板应力强度因子计算验证，并与Ti-6Al-4V ELI疲劳实验数据对比
English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a multi-scale simulation framework for deformation and damage analysis of large structures under complex loadings.
Method· A nested sub-modeling finite element framework is established, transferring displacement solutions from global to local scales, integrated with crystal plasticity and a fatigue indicator parameter model.
Result· Stress and strain errors in shell and cracked plate are within 5%, and predicted shear fatigue lives of Ti-6Al-4V ELI agree with experiments within 10% error.
Validation· Validated against hydrostatic pressure test of shell structure, stress intensity factor of cracked plate, and experimental fatigue data of Ti-6Al-4V ELI.

Md Shafiqur Rahman Jame, Ankita Roy, Dang Toan Truong, Haojun You, Abdulaziz Alfaifi et al. Journal of Manufacturing Processes 2026-07-01 10.1016/j.jmapro.2026.06.071
相关性: 该论文直接研究了L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的工艺控制（开环与闭环）对微观结构和力学性能的影响，符合L1方向对机械性能的关注。
边界: The paper does not explicitly address fatigue performance, but it is still relevant as it covers tensile properties and microstructure which are part of L1 focus.
动机· 研究开环与闭环原位过程控制对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。
方法· 对比开环和闭环两种控制策略，进行L-PBF成型，然后表征微观结构和力学性能。
结果· 闭环控制能显著改善微观结构均匀性和力学性能（如强度、延展性）。
验证· 通过拉伸测试、硬度测试和显微组织观察进行实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the effect of open-loop versus closed-loop in-situ process control on the microstructure and mechanical properties of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· Two control strategies were implemented during L-PBF, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing (tensile and hardness).
Result· Closed-loop control improved microstructural homogeneity and enhanced mechanical properties including strength and ductility.
Validation· Experimental validation through tensile tests, hardness measurements, and microscopy analysis.

Effect of Repeated Powder Reuse on the Quality and Mechanical Properties of Ti-6Al-4V Fabricated by Laser Powder Bed Fusion

Jae H. Kim, Seong-Jin Park, Hyomoon Joo, Jae‐Keun Hong Journal of Welding and Joining 2026-06-30 10.5781/jwj.2026.44.3.7
单位: Lightweight Materials Research Division, Korea Institute of Materials Science, Changwon, 51508, Korea
相关性: 该论文直接研究了激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V粉末重复使用对力学性能的影响，属于L1方向的核心内容。
边界: This paper does not model or predict mechanical/fatigue behavior; it provides only experimental characterization and a practical reuse limit based on oxygen and ductility.
动机· 评估LPBF Ti-6Al-4V粉末重复使用对制品质量与力学性能的影响。
方法· 将气体雾化Ti-6Al-4V粉末重复使用多达15次，检测粉末形貌、氧含量、硬度、拉伸性能及微观组织。
结果· 重复使用15次后硬度升至411 HV，伸长率从10.7%降至7.4%，氧含量超标，提出了6次重复使用上限。
验证· 通过硬度测试、拉伸试验、SEM-EDS和光学显微镜进行实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the effect of repeated powder reuse on the quality and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by laser powder bed fusion.
Method· Gas-atomized Ti-6Al-4V powder was reused up to 15 build cycles, and changes in powder morphology, oxygen content, hardness, tensile properties, and microstructure were characterized.
Result· Hardness increased, elongation decreased from 10.7% to 7.4%, oxygen exceeded the ASTM limit after 6 cycles, and a practical reuse limit of 6 cycles was proposed.
Validation· Experimental validation through mechanical testing (hardness, tensile), SEM-EDS, and optical microscopy.

边界: 论文重点在于开发预测模型而非提供新的实验疲劳数据或S-N曲线，机械表征可能仅限于模型构建。
动机· 针对激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V部件疲劳失效风险预测的挑战。
方法· 结合力学测试与有限元分析，建立多元回归预测模型。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To address the challenge of predicting fatigue failure risk for Ti-6Al-4V parts produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion.
Method· An integrated experimental-computational approach combining tensile and fatigue testing with finite element simulations and multiple regression analysis.
Result· The developed model achieves high accuracy in predicting fatigue life with R² values near 0.95 and low RMSE.
Validation· The model is validated using k-fold cross-validation (k=5) with performance metrics R² and RMSE.

相关性: 该论文直接研究冷喷涂Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能（硬度、弯曲强度），属于L1方向覆盖的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V机械性能表征。
边界: No fatigue testing; only flexural and hardness characterization without S-N data or fatigue crack initiation/growth.
动机· 研究陶瓷增强相对冷喷涂Ti-6Al-4V沉积层微观结构和力学性能的影响。
方法· 制备Ti-6Al-4V和Ti-6Al-4V/SiC多层沉积层，进行显微组织、硬度和弯曲性能测试。

English summary & terms
Motivation· This study investigates how ceramic reinforcement affects the microstructure and mechanical properties of cold-sprayed Ti-6Al-4V deposits.
Method· Multilayer Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-4V/SiC deposits on steel substrate with nickel interlayer were prepared and characterized by microscopy, hardness, and flexural tests on freestanding specimens.
Result· Incorporation of SiC increased local hardness but reduced overall flexural strength and stiffness, increasing structural heterogeneity.
Validation· Validation was performed via SEM, microhardness mapping, and three-point bending with fractographic analysis.

Fatigue Behavior of Hybrid Additive/Subtractive Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V

Nicholas Parolini, Andrew Ikeler, Ryan Kinser, Abhendra K. Singh, Paul Allison et al. Metals 2026-06-18 10.3390/met16060673
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Baylor University, Waco, TX 76706, USA
通讯: J. B. Jordon @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Baylor University, Waco, TX 76706, USA
相关性: 该文直接研究Ti-6Al-4V的CNC加工后处理对疲劳性能的影响，完全符合L2方向要求。
边界: This paper only covers CNC machining as post-processing; it does not investigate heat treatment, HIP, shot peening, or other surface treatments that are also within the L2 direction.
动机· 研究混合增/减材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳行为，评估机械加工后处理的影响。
方法· 采用激光丝材定向能量沉积结合CNC加工制备试样，进行硬度、拉伸和疲劳测试。
结果· 疲劳寿命低于锻件，符合Basquin幂律，疲劳强度系数1942 MPa，指数-0.115。
验证· 通过显微硬度、单轴拉伸和全反向轴向疲劳实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by additive-subtractive hybrid manufacturing (ASHM) with CNC machining as post-processing.
Method· Specimens were produced via laser wire-directed energy deposition (LW-DED) combined with CNC machining, followed by hardness mapping, monotonic tensile testing, and fully reversed axial fatigue testing.
Result· The ASHM material showed reduced fatigue life compared to wrought Ti-6Al-4V, following a Basquin power-law fit with a fatigue strength coefficient of 1942 MPa and exponent of -0.115, with fatigue life dependent on porosity from the additive process.
Validation· Validation was conducted through micro-hardness mapping, tensile tests, and high-cycle fatigue experiments.

English summary & terms
Motivation· This study investigates the effect of TiC reinforcement content on the tensile and fatigue behavior of LPBF-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
Method· Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-4V/TiC composites with varying TiC weight fractions were produced by LPBF and characterized via tensile, fracture toughness, and fatigue crack growth tests.
Result· TiC addition improved tensile strength by 15.3% and fatigue endurance strength by 15.2%, but reduced ductility from 11.5% to 4.6%; fracture toughness increased from 58.6 to 68.5 MPa√m.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing was supplemented by SEM fractography and EDS elemental mapping to confirm microstructure and fracture mechanisms.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To design a load-bearing bone scaffold that mimics the transverse isotropy of cortical bone using a modified lattice structure.
Method· A hybrid octet-truss and cross-strut unit cell (OT-C) was developed, and numerical homogenization with longitudinal expansion was used to tailor the anisotropic elastic moduli.
Result· An expansion ratio of 1.4 and 60% porosity yielded E1 ≈ 13 GPa, E3 ≈ 22.5 GPa, and a ratio E3/E1 ≈ 1.73, closely matching human cortical bone.
Validation· Compression tests on SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V samples confirmed the numerical predictions.

动机· 研究构建取向和后处理热处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V力学性能的影响
方法· 对0°、45°、90°取向试样进行应力消除(650°C/3h)和HIP(920°C/100MPa/2h)处理，测试拉伸、高周疲劳和断裂韧性

English summary & terms
Motivation· To systematically investigate the effects of build orientation and post-process heat treatments (stress relief and hot isostatic pressing) on the mechanical properties of SLM Ti-6Al-4V for aerospace applications.
Method· Specimens built at 0°, 45°, and 90° orientations were subjected to stress relief (650°C/3 h) and HIP (920°C/100 MPa/2 h), followed by tensile, high-cycle fatigue (R=0.1, 10⁷-cycle runout), and fracture toughness (Kᴵᶜ) testing.
Result· HIP treatment increased fatigue strength at 10⁷ cycles from 390 MPa to 580 MPa and improved Kᴵᶜ by 61% to 71 MPa·m¹/², approaching wrought-annealed values.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing including tensile, fatigue, and fracture toughness measurements.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V produces anisotropic mechanical properties due to columnar grain growth and α′ martensite, requiring post-process control.
Method· The study systematically examines the effects of two post-process heat treatments (stress relief at 650°C and HIP at 920°C/100 MPa) on tensile, high-cycle fatigue, and fracture toughness of SLM Ti-6Al-4V.
Result· HIP treatment transformed α′ to α+β, eliminated pores, increased fatigue strength from 390 to 580 MPa, and improved fracture toughness by 61%.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing (tensile, fatigue, fracture toughness) was conducted and compared with as-built and wrought-annealed conditions.

Motivation· To investigate the combined effects of manufacturing-induced geometrical imperfections and a physiological environment on the corrosion-fatigue behavior of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V lattice struts.
Method· Thin strut specimens built at 60° orientation were tested under tension-tension fatigue in air and PBS at 37°C, with micro-CT characterization of surface roughness and porosity.
Result· Fatigue life was defect-sensitive; PBS reduced high-cycle fatigue strength by about 25% at 10^6 cycles, with surface valleys dominating crack initiation.
Validation· Fractography and EDXS confirmed environment-assisted crack propagation, and micro-CT deepest-valley analysis predicted critical defects consistent with failure locations.

Validation· Validated through single-bead trials, thin-wall and conical builds, followed by mechanical tensile testing and microstructural analysis.

动机· 为应力消除PBF-LB/M Ti-6Al-4V提供工艺参数与疲劳性能关联的数据集。
方法· 使用175个试样，改变扫描速度，进行四点和轴向疲劳测试及断口SEM分析。
结果· 得到包含疲劳寿命、裂纹萌生位置和缺陷形态的完整数据集。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To provide a curated dataset linking process parameters to fatigue outcomes for stress-relieved PBF-LB/M Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· 175 specimens fabricated at varying scan velocities (800–2000 mm/s) at constant power, fatigue tested, and characterized via post-mortem SEM.
Result· The dataset includes fatigue lives, crack initiation sites, and defect morphology metrics for 136 fractured specimens and runout data.
Validation· Experimental validation via fatigue testing (load-controlled, R=0.1) and fractographic analysis.

A unified probabilistic defect-based fatigue modelling approach to account for surface and bulk defects in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys and defect characterisation

Enrico Salvati, Marco Pelegatti, Marco Petruzzi, Alessandro Tognan, Emanuele Avoledo et al. International Journal of Fatigue 2026-04-02 10.1016/j.ijfatigue.2026.109659
相关性: 该论文直接研究Ti-6Al-4V合金的后处理（热等静压、真空热处理）对疲劳性能的影响，符合L2方向要求。
边界: This paper does not focus on a single post-processing route's effect on microstructure or tensile properties; instead, it presents a defect-based fatigue model calibrated on multiple post-processing conditions.
动机· 增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的缺陷严重影响疲劳性能，需要统一模型来评估表面和内部缺陷的影响。
方法· 提出基于概率断裂力学的缺陷模型，结合CT和极值统计，并使用不同后处理条件进行校准。
结果· 模型能有效预测不同后处理状态下Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳极限，提供概率失效评估。
验证· 通过EBM和SLM两种工艺制造的Ti-6Al-4V在不同后处理后的疲劳实验数据验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· The fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V is severely degraded by defects, necessitating a unified model to account for both surface and bulk defects under various post-processing conditions.
Method· A probabilistic defect-based fatigue model integrating fracture mechanics, computed tomography, and extreme value statistics is calibrated on Ti-6Al-4V specimens subjected to hot isostatic pressing, vacuum heat treatment, and as-built conditions.
Result· The proposed model effectively predicts the fatigue endurance limit across all studied material states, providing a probabilistic assessment of failure.
Validation· The model is validated against an extensive experimental fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V manufactured by electron beam melting and selective laser melting with different post-processing treatments.

动机· 增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学性能不及锻件，需通过后处理改善。

Result· Surface treatments greatly improved tensile and fatigue strength, and heat treatment further enhanced the fatigue limit.

Xiao Zhang, Yi Zuo, Zhuotao Fan Journal of Physics Conference Series 2026-04-01 10.1088/1742-6596/3207/1/012124
单位: Shanghai Aircraft Design and Research Institute, Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd., Shanghai, 200135, P. R. China

边界: This paper does not include microstructural analysis or porosity closure data, focusing only on fatigue performance and DFR quantification.
动机· 研究喷丸处理对Ti-6Al-4V钛合金疲劳性能的影响。
方法· 对Ti-6Al-4V板进行不同强度的喷丸处理，开展疲劳试验并计算DFR。
结果· 喷丸处理最大提高DFR达48.50%，中等强度效果最佳。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To experimentally investigate the effect of shot peening on the fatigue performance of Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy.
Method· Fatigue tests were conducted on Ti-6Al-4V plates subjected to five different shot peening intensities, and the detailed fatigue rating (DFR) was calculated.
Result· Shot peening significantly improved fatigue resistance, with a maximum DFR gain of 48.50%, and an intermediate peening intensity yielded the optimal enhancement.
Validation· The findings are validated through systematic fatigue experiments across multiple peening intensities.

单位: Department of Engineering Science, University West, Trollhättan, SE-461 86, Sweden
通讯: Linda Squillaci @ Department of Engineering Science, University West, Trollhättan, SE-461 86, Sweden
相关性: 该论文直接研究了热等静压（HIP）处理温度对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能的影响，完全符合后处理控制方向。
边界: Only considers HIP, not other post-processes like machining or peening; however, this is a core study within the HIP sub-topic.
动机· 探究HIP温度（亚/超β相变点）对消除缺陷后疲劳寿命的控制机制
方法· 制备两种缺陷水平的PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V，分别进行亚β和超β HIP处理，进行疲劳测试和微观表征
结果· 亚β HIP的细α结构延长疲劳寿命，超β HIP的粗α团簇促进裂纹萌生
验证· 通过疲劳试验、CT和EBSD验证缺陷消除和微观结构影响
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate whether HIP temperature (sub/super β transus) governs fatigue life after defect closure in PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· Two sets of PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V specimens with different initial defect levels were HIP treated below or above the β transus, then subjected to fatigue testing and microstructural characterization.
Result· Sub-β HIP produced a fine α structure that improved fatigue life, while super-β HIP formed coarse α colonies that localized cyclic slip and promoted early crack initiation.
Validation· Fatigue tests, X-ray computed tomography for porosity, and EBSD for crystallographic orientation validated the microstructural effects.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To address the lack of accurate fatigue life prediction methods for TC4 bolted structures operating at moderate elevated temperatures up to 400°C.
Method· An enhanced detail fatigue rating (DFR) method was developed by incorporating temperature-dependent thermal influences based on fatigue test data of TC4 base material at 20°C, 200°C, and 400°C.
Result· The enhanced DFR method improved the average fatigue life prediction accuracy by 9.29% compared to the conventional DFR method within the 20–400°C range.

Motivation· To predict crack-initiating defects and estimate the fatigue limit of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V using Murakami's area-parameter model, with different heat treatments.

Validation· Experimental fatigue testing combined with post-mortem SEM and xCT imaging validates defect-based fatigue life predictions.

Method· A Design of Experiment (DOE) was employed to define 16 topological configurations, and 48 specimens (three replicas each) were manufactured in random order; compressive tests, optical microscopy, and micro-CT were conducted.

Method· Monotonic tensile tests, symmetric strain-controlled low-cycle fatigue tests, and asymmetric stress-controlled ratchetting-fatigue interaction tests were conducted on vertically and horizontally built LPBF Ti6Al4V specimens.

结果· 250°C时氧化膜/TTS降低平均摩擦但降低损伤阈值，450°C时损伤热点移至次表面，累计能量阈值较室温下降45–65%。

English summary & terms
Motivation· The temperature dependence of fretting fatigue crack initiation mechanisms in Ti-6Al-4V remains insufficiently quantified, especially the transition from mechanically-driven to oxide-assisted mechanisms at elevated temperatures.
Method· Cylinder-on-flat fretting tests were conducted at 20°C, 250°C, and 450°C, with synchronous infrared and micro-thermocouple thermometry, and supplemented by a validated 3D thermomechanically coupled finite element model.
Result· Crack initiation at 250°C is dominated by oxide film and tribologically transformed structures, reducing the cumulative energy threshold by 25–35%, while at 450°C intergranular mechanisms shift damage subsurface, further lowering the threshold by 20–30%.
Validation· The coupled FEM was validated by comparing predicted temperature maps with experimental measurements, achieving a peak mismatch ≤8%.

Stiffness and Damping Properties of LPBF-Fabricated TC4 Alloy Beams Incorporating Self-Sealing Powder and Lattice Structures

Yong Xu, Zheng Xiang, Chenyu Zhang, Jingang Tang, Xiaohui Ge et al. Metals 2025-12-29 10.3390/met16010040
单位: Institute of Systems Engineering, CAEP, Mianyang 621999, China
通讯: Jie Chen @ Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, CAEP, Mianyang 621000, China  |  Shuke Huang @ Institute of Machinery Manufacturing Technology, CAEP, Mianyang 621000, China
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的TC4（Ti-6Al-4V）合金梁的刚度和阻尼性能，属于L1方向的力学表征。
边界: 论文未涉及疲劳寿命、S-N曲线或拉伸强度等典型力学/疲劳指标，而是聚焦于刚度和阻尼性能。
动机· 为实现LPBF自封粉末阻尼组件刚度和阻尼的协同提升。
方法· 设计制备含自封粉末和点阵结构的TC4梁，表征制造质量、力学和阻尼性能，建立静动态模型。
结果· 增大点阵支柱直径提高刚度，降低放大因子和结构阻尼比；含点阵梁在显著提升刚度的同时保持较大阻尼比。
验证· 通过振动测试和力学实验验证模型与性能。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To achieve synergistic improvement in stiffness and damping of LPBF-fabricated self-sealing powder damping components by incorporating lattice structures.
Method· Designed and fabricated TC4 alloy beams with self-sealing powder and lattice structures, characterized their manufacturing quality, mechanical properties, and damping performance, and developed static and dynamic models.
Result· Increasing lattice strut diameter increased stiffness while decreasing amplification factor and structural damping ratio; beams with lattice structures (0.6 mm and 0.9 mm strut diameters) showed significant stiffness improvement and maintained large damping ratios under 1g and 2g vibration inputs.
Validation· Experimental vibration and mechanical testing validated the models and performance improvements.

Motivation· Porosity defects in laser powder bed fusion of Ti-6Al-4V limit its application, necessitating accurate prediction models.
Method· A physics-informed computational framework resolving transient thermal fields, melt pool dynamics, and temperature-dependent material properties was developed with a graphical user interface.
Result· The model predictions of porosity showed strong quantitative agreement with literature experimental data (Archimedes, µ-CT, micrograph).
Validation· Validation was performed against experimentally reported melt pool geometries and porosity datasets from the literature.

边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed analysis of fatigue life; it focuses on tensile properties and ductility via α′ decomposition.
动机· 改善LPBF Ti-6Al-4V因残余应力导致的低延展性，通过热处理分解α′相。
方法· 在不同温度(500°C和700°C)下对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V进行热处理，分析微观结构和力学性能。
结果· 500°C热处理提高屈服强度但降低延展性；700°C热处理通过粗化β相提高延展性。
验证· 通过拉伸测试和微观结构表征验证热处理效果。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To improve the ductility of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V alloys by heat treatment to decompose the α′ martensitic phase and reduce residual stress.
Method· Heat treatment at 500°C and 700°C was applied to LPBF Ti-6Al-4V samples, and the resulting microstructures and tensile properties were characterized.
Result· Heat treatment at 500°C increased yield strength but decreased ductility, while treatment at 700°C enhanced ductility via coarser β phase precipitation and slip transfer.
Validation· Validation was performed through tensile testing and microstructural analysis using SEM and EBSD.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of post-processing heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of additively manufactured titanium alloys.
Method· Samples were subjected to solution treatment at 850-1000 °C followed by aging at 500 °C, then characterized by microhardness and tensile tests.
Result· Heat treatment reduced microhardness by 15% for Ti-6Al-4V, while Ti-6Al-7Nb showed higher elongation (7.7%) due to greater β-phase fraction.
Validation· Validation was performed through experimental microhardness measurements and tensile testing.

动机· 优化激光金属沉积Ti6Al4V工艺并研究后处理对力学性能的影响。

Motivation· To optimize the laser metal deposition process for Ti6Al4V and evaluate the effects of post-processing treatments on mechanical properties.
Method· Response surface methodology and ANOVA were used for parameter optimization, followed by hot isostatic pressing, heat treatment, and cryogenic treatment. Mechanical testing and porosity analysis were performed.
Result· Post-processing reduced strength but significantly improved ductility and reduced porosity; cryogenic treatment further refined the microstructure and increased elongation.
Validation· Experimental mechanical tests and porosity measurements validated the effects of each post-processing route.

边界: The paper is fully in scope; no missing elements relative to the direction focus.
动机· 研究SLM Ti6Al4V在400°C下不同应力比的高周疲劳行为及寿命预测。
方法· 开展高周疲劳试验并观察断口，结合疲劳与蠕变损伤建立复合模型。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the high-cycle fatigue behavior of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V alloy at 400°C under various stress ratios for aerospace applications.
Method· High-cycle fatigue tests were conducted at stress ratios of -1 to 0.8, fracture surfaces were observed, and combined fatigue-creep damage models were developed using linear damage law.
Result· Surface/subsurface defects acted as crack initiation sites; fatigue life dispersion decreased with increasing stress ratio, and the composite model provided the best life prediction.
Validation· Predicted fatigue lives from single and composite models were compared against experimental data to identify the most accurate model.

动机· 研究热处理和热等静压对PBF-EB制备Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。
方法· 进行固溶时效处理和不同HIP循环，分析孔隙率、显微组织和拉伸性能。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate how post-processing heat treatments and hot isostatic pressing modify the microstructure and mechanical behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by electron beam powder bed fusion.
Method· Solution treatment and aging, as well as HIP cycles at various temperatures and pressures, were applied, followed by porosity analysis, microstructural characterization, and tensile testing.
Result· HIP effectively reduced porosity; the 800°C/200 MPa cycle achieved the best combination of strength (yield 948 MPa, UTS 1013 MPa) and ductility, while super-transus HIP caused strength loss due to lath coarsening.
Validation· Experimental validation via relative density measurements, optical microscopy/SEM, and uniaxial tensile tests.

Motivation· This study investigates whether different Ti-6Al-4V powder feedstocks from various manufacturers affect the mechanical properties of directed energy deposition (DED) fabricated bulk specimens under identical processing parameters.
Method· Four Ti64 powders from three manufacturers were characterized and used to print coupons at varying build angles, followed by tensile, hardness, and strain measurements, with statistical analysis to validate observed variances.
Result· Significant differences in ultimate tensile strength, strain, and hardness were found among powder variants, attributed to discrepancies in volume flow rate and powder morphology despite similar density and mass flow rates.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing combined with statistical analysis validated that powder quality contributes to variance in as-built mechanical properties.

动机· 探究激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V在高应变率和高温下的动态力学行为。

English summary & terms
Motivation· The study investigates the dynamic mechanical behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V under high strain rates and elevated temperatures relevant to aerospace applications.
Method· High-temperature compressive Split-Hopkinson Pressure Bar tests were conducted at strain rates of 1000 and 2000 s⁻¹ across temperatures from 298 to 773 K, followed by constitutive modeling using modified Johnson-Cook, Hensel-Spittel, and modified Hensel-Spittel models.
Result· Adiabatic shear bands formed at high strain rates caused deviations in model predictions; the modified Hensel-Spittel model exhibited the lowest average absolute relative errors (5.51%) and highest correlation coefficient (0.95).
Validation· Experimental SHPB stress-strain data and microstructural characterization validated the constitutive model predictions.

边界: The paper directly addresses mechanical anisotropy and fatigue crack growth in as-built Ti-6Al-4V; it does not cover post-processing or implant-specific contexts, which are out of scope for this direction.
动机· 研究高沉积速率增材制造α+β钛合金中柱状和等轴β晶粒结构对力学各向异性的影响。
方法· 通过线弧增材制造制备Ti-6Al-4V试样，进行多取向拉伸和疲劳试验，结合晶体塑性模拟。
结果· 柱状晶粒在45°方向显示真实屈服各向异性，粗晶界α相增加疲劳裂纹扩展数据分散性，细化β晶粒可改善。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the impact of columnar versus equiaxed β-grain structures on mechanical anisotropy in high-deposition-rate additively manufactured α+β titanium alloys.
Method· Wire-arc additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Zr-2Mo-0.1Si specimens, tensile and fatigue testing at multiple orientations, combined with crystal plasticity simulations.
Result· True yield-stress anisotropy in columnar grain samples is revealed at 45° orientation, and large grain boundary α colonies on columnar β-grain boundaries significantly increase fatigue crack growth rate scatter; refining β-grains resolves these issues.
Validation· Uniaxial tensile tests and fatigue crack growth tests.

English summary & terms
Motivation· The study isolates the intrinsic effect of cooling rate on the mechanical behavior of martensitic Ti-6Al-4V to resolve the debated role of α′ in brittleness versus toughness.
Method· A Gleeble thermal simulator was used to apply precisely controlled cooling rates up to ~7000 °C/s, producing α/β, αm/α′, and fully α′ microstructures, which were then characterized by compression tests and EVP-FFT crystal plasticity modeling.
Result· Ultra-fast-cooled fully martensitic Ti-6Al-4V achieved simultaneous improvement in both strength and fracture strain, with densely distributed elongated dimples indicating ductile failure.
Validation· Experimental compression tests and three-dimensional microstructure-based crystal plasticity simulations provided validation.

Motivation· To develop a computationally efficient physics-based modeling framework for predicting microstructure-dependent mechanical properties of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.

Shiyue Guo, Rusheng Zhao, Huiling Tang, Xiangyu Guo, Jian Wang et al. Results in Engineering 2025-09-07 10.1016/j.rineng.2025.107163
单位: Hubei Longzhong Laboratory, Xiangyang 441000, China
通讯: Rusheng Zhao @ Graduate School of Systems Design, Tokyo Metropolitan University, Tokyo 1910065, Japan
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制备的多孔Ti-6Al-4V合金的力学性能，包括能量吸收和各向异性，属于L1方向核心内容。
边界: This paper focuses on porous structures rather than solid mechanical characterization, but it still provides experimental mechanical data for Ti-6Al-4V AM, which is within scope; no fatigue testing is performed.
动机· 克服多孔Ti-6Al-4V各向异性和应力集中问题。
方法· 设计梯度无序结构并采用L-PBF制备，结合压缩实验和有限元模拟。
结果· 梯度无序结构使能量吸收提升600%，各向异性降低96%。
验证· 通过压缩实验和FEA验证了力学性能改善。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To overcome mechanical anisotropy and stress concentration in porous Ti-6Al-4V alloys for enhanced energy absorption.
Method· Gradient-disordered porous architectures based on trapezo-rhombic dodecahedron cells were designed and fabricated via laser powder bed fusion, then characterized by compression tests and finite element simulations.
Result· The gradient-disordered designs achieved up to 600% increase in energy absorption and reduced anisotropy in modulus and absorption by 96% and 93%, respectively, resulting in nearly isotropic behavior.
Validation· Experimental compression tests and finite element simulations confirmed improved isotropy, suppressed shear bands, and uniform stress distribution.

Motivation· This study aims to investigate the effect of deposition temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V processed by additive friction stir deposition (AFSD).

English summary & terms
Motivation· To elucidate the deformation mechanisms of L-PBF-processed Ti-6Al-4V, which are not yet fully understood.
Method· In-situ high-energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD) combined with crystal plasticity finite element modeling was used to compare the deformation behavior of the α' phase in as-built specimens and the α phase in heat-treated specimens.
Result· The slip activation sequence differs: prismatic→basal→pyramidal I <c+a> for α' and basal→prismatic→pyramidal I <c+a> for α, with higher CRSS values in α' for all slip systems except prismatic.
Validation· Experimental HEXRD data (FWHM and peak intensity evolution) validated the predicted slip activation sequences and elastic anisotropy.

English summary & terms
Motivation· Conventional pure shear fatigue tests are time-consuming and expensive, motivating the development of a faster, reliable method.
Method· A novel vibration-based fatigue test for pure shear loading was designed using plate specimens, validated with strain rosettes, and applied at 700 Hz on an electrodynamic shaker.
Result· Fatigue strengths of as-built L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V obtained at 700 Hz matched standard torsion test results at 5 Hz, with all failures initiating at lack of fusion or surface roughness features.
Validation· Experimental validation included strain rosette measurements and fractographic analysis confirming edge-free crack initiation in the high-stress zone.

Motivation· Infinite life design based on traditional fatigue limit is unsafe for components requiring over 10^8 cycles, necessitating improved fatigue life prediction models for Ti-6Al-4V.

Result· The proposed models fit the experimental data well, and after parameter optimization via sensitivity analysis, the average prediction error decreased from 59% to 38%.
Validation· Model accuracy was validated against fatigue test data, and parameter sensitivity analysis was performed.

Method· One-step and two-step annealing treatments were applied to cold-drawn wires at temperatures between 500°C and 800°C in the α+β regime.

动机· 探究超转态热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V(ELI)压缩性能的影响。
方法· 进行超转态固溶时效处理，用OM和SEM表征微观结构，并实施压缩测试。

Motivation· To investigate the effect of supertransus heat treatment on the compressive behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V (ELI).
Method· Specimens were subjected to solution treatment and aging above the β-transus, with microstructure characterized by OM and SEM and compressive tests conducted.
Result· Heat treatment reduced compressive strength but improved elongation, with microstructural changes closely correlating to compressive properties.
Validation· Experimental validation was performed through compressive mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.

单位: State Key Laboratory of High-performance Precision Manufacturing, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China

相关性: 该论文通过同步锤锻方法改善了激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和力学性能，直接相关于增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的基础力学与疲劳性能研究。
边界: The paper focuses on grain refinement and mechanical properties via in-situ hammer forging, but does not specifically address fatigue life or S-N curves, which are core to the fatigue direction.
动机· 为了解决激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V构件粗大柱状晶和性能不足的问题。
方法· 在激光沉积过程中引入同步锤锻，实现动态再结晶和晶粒细化。
结果· 获得了等轴细晶组织，拉伸强度和塑性同时提升。
验证· 通过显微组织观察和室温拉伸试验验证了该方法的效果。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To overcome the coarse columnar grains and inadequate mechanical properties of laser directed energy deposited Ti-6Al-4V components.
Method· Synchronous hammer forging was applied during the deposition process to induce dynamic recrystallization and grain refinement.
Result· Equiaxed fine grains were obtained, resulting in simultaneous improvement of tensile strength and ductility.
Validation· Microstructural characterization and room-temperature tensile testing confirmed the effectiveness of the method.

Supapat Trithepchunlayakoon, Aung Nyein Soe, Atikom Sombatmai, Suppakrit Khrueaduangkham, Vorapat Trachoo et al. PLoS ONE 2025-06-03 10.1371/journal.pone.0325276

相关性: 该论文直接针对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI合金的工艺参数-孔隙-力学性能关系，完全符合L1层对Ti-6Al-4V增材制造力学性能的关注。
边界: No fatigue or cyclic loading data; only quasi-static tensile properties are reported.
动机· 研究激光能量密度对L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI合金孔隙形态和力学性能的影响。
方法· 改变激光功率（75-175 W），利用Archimedes法、OM和Micro-CT分析孔隙，并进行拉伸测试。
结果· 最优参数下孔隙率0.3%，未熔合缺陷比气孔和匙孔对拉伸性能影响更大。
验证· 通过Archimedes法、光学显微镜、Micro-CT和拉伸测试进行实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To systematically investigate the effect of laser energy density on void morphology, microstructure, and mechanical properties of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V ELI alloy.
Method· Samples fabricated with laser power from 75 to 175 W were analyzed using Archimedes method, optical microscopy, micro-CT, surface roughness measurement, and tensile testing.
Result· Optimal parameters yielded 0.3% porosity, with lack-of-fusion defects more detrimental than gas pores or keyhole pores, and energy density critically influencing defect generation and tensile properties.
Validation· Experimental characterization via Archimedes method, OM, Micro-CT, and tensile testing.
